title: Zesty Croatian Shrimp Skewers
description: A mustardy and springy Croatian dish featuring gochugaru, perfect for a date night, served in a stone bowl, and Buddhist temple friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together gochugaru, Dijon mustard, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Serve the skewers in a stone bowl, garnished with lemon wedges and fresh parsley.
Cook the skewers to an internal temperature of at least 145 degrees.
Let the skewers rest for 2 minutes before serving.
